steps.analysis: This is a global app-launch action with no element lookup; it depends on the Contacts app being available and may fail if the app name is localized or changed, so use the binding-provided app name when present.

app_name = binding.get("app_name") or "Contacts"
if not app_name:
    raise ValueError("Cannot open app: no app name available in binding")
device.open_app(app_name)
device.settle(1.0)

steps.analysis: Depends on the Contacts home screen exposing a clickable control whose accessibility description is “Create contact”; if another screen or app variant uses a different description or no clickable element, lookup fails.

if idx is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Could not find the 'Create contact' button on the Contacts screen")
device.click(index=idx)
device.settle(1.0)
